notes: CPU-only PC (8 GB RAM): local Ollama models PLUS two hosted models in ONE gateway, so nothing needs switching: hosted/nemotron-nano-reasoning (OpenRouter free, zone public-api, key OPENROUTER_API_KEY) and bedrock/nemotron-nano-3-30b (Amazon Bedrock, ap-southeast-2, zone private-cloud, key BEDROCK_API_KEY). Used by test-console/modes/ollama-cpu-8gb-all.json, which starts the gateway with --auto-zones local --phi-zones local: chainaim/auto and health data stay on this PC; a hosted model answers only when a client names it. Only masked text reaches any model. Keys are read from the environment (hidden prompts in switch-models.ps1), never written. Bedrock's deployment, context and price are copied from config/catalog.bedrock.json (v1.0.4): baseUrl verified there by rig R5; price = AWS Standard on-demand for Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B in Asia Pacific (Sydney), USD 0.0618 / 0.2472 per 1M input / output tokens, read from aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing on 2026-10-24 (per that file).
